item.title: My Journey with ChatGPT for Business: Unleashing the Power of AI for Software Engineers
item.description:
Introduction

As a software engineer, I’m constantly searching for tools and technologies that can revolutionize the way I work. Today, I want to share a prototype app: ChatGPT for Business. I believe if we follow through on building this, it has the potential to transform our industry. Join me as I take you through my experiences, challenges, and the immense possibilities that lie ahead.

item.title: What are MSON Template Queries?
item.description: Template Queries are dynamic templates constructed with MongoDB-style operators. They allow you to customize MSON components with less code and are very extensible.

item.title: How to autogenerate forms in React and Material-UI with MSON
item.description: Implementing great forms can be a real time-waster. With just a few lines of JSON, you can use MSON to generate forms that perform real-time validation and have a consistent layout. And, MSON comes with a bunch of cool stuff like date pickers, masked fields and field collections.

item.title: Creating a New Programming Language That Will Allow Anyone to Make Software
item.description: I’ve spent the last 7 months working on a new programming language called MSON. Here is a nerdy post about why I did it, how it works and where I want to take it.
